dct_title_s: Transportation Plan: Project Recommendations, MAPC, Massachusetts, 1993 (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This layer is a georeferenced raster image of the historic paper map entitled: The 1993 transportation plan : project recommendations. It was published by the Metropolitan Area Planning Council in 1993. Scale not given. The image inside the map neatline is georeferenced to the surface of the earth and fit to the Massachusetts State Plane Coordinate System, Mainland Zone (in Feet) (Fipszone 2001). All map collar and inset information is also available as part of the raster image, including any inset maps, profiles, statistical tables, directories, text, illustrations, index maps, legends, or other information associated with the principal map. This map shows features such as major roads, railroads, drainage, cities and other human settlements, territorial boundaries, shoreline features, and more. Marked as draft. Includes also list of short-term transportation projects, list of long-term transportation project, and legend showing short-term and long-term transit and highway plans. This layer is part of a selection of digitally scanned and georeferenced historic maps from the Harvard Map Collection. These maps typically portray both natural and manmade features. The selection represents a range of originators, ground condition dates, scales, and map purposes.

Purpose: Historic paper maps can provide an excellent view of the changes that have occurred in the cultural and physical landscape. The wide range of information provided on these maps make them useful in the study of historic geography, and urban and rural land use change. As this map has been georeferenced, it can be used in a GIS as a source or background layer in conjunction with other GIS data.
